theme: Open water, one call, and Saturday's landing to settle
greeting: An open day on the water, Dan, with just the NACD programming call breaking the afternoon. The real work is on dry land: the charter ends Saturday, so the Cavtat transfers and the Florida landing want locking in while you still have signal.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Cavtat disembark logistics
needsAttention.detail: The charter ends noon Saturday at Komolac. The transfer to Cavtat, a bag hold before 3 PM check-in, and a ~5:15 AM Sunday checkout for the 7:30 flight all need arranging from land before the boat's signal thins.

needsAttention.title: Book the TPA rental car outright
needsAttention.detail: Full-size SUV at Tampa, Sept 20 to Oct 5, to seat all six. You land Sunday at 3:55 PM, so this can't be a walk-up on a jet-lagged Sunday afternoon.

needsAttention.title: Hold the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: A refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week is the thinnest rental in that market over the holiday and it sells out. The task was due Sept 14.

flagged.title: myFICO alert: account balance decreased
flagged.detail: Automated credit-monitoring ping on a SYNCB/NTWK account, informational only, nothing to act on.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and retail: Foreign Affairs, Responsible Investor, Midcoast Villager, NYT Cooking, and a stack of promos.
inbox.clear: Nothing in the inbox is waiting on your reply.

recipe.title: Apple galette
recipe.why: Autumn's first apples are crisp and tart now, made for a free-form galette.

tasks.title: Book St Pete lodging for the Sept 20-22 landing gap
Confirm the Nautilus return transfer to the airport
Check the St Pete Airbnb confirmed before the Sept 18 charge

acts.line: Open water and nothing on the calendar, the last easy stretch of the charter is yours.
One commitment breaks the day: the NACD New England programming call at one.
As the coast slips past, Saturday's move to dry land is the thing worth settling before the signal thins.
